title: The uncountability of the reals and the Axiom of Choice
summary: The uncountability of the reals was first established by Cantor in what was later heralded as the first paper on set theory. Since the latter constitutes the official foundations of mathematics, the logical study of the uncountability of the reals is a worthy endeavour for historical, foundational, and conceptual reasons. In this paper, we shall study the following principle: $\textsf{NIN}_{[0,1]}$: there is no injection from the unit interval to the natural numbers.
